text: Future financial crises may be inevitable, because globalization, financial innovation, ethical challenges, suboptimal institutional designs, and the bounded rationality of decision makers create conditions that produce crises.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857

isBasedOn.name: Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry

abstract: Future financial crises may be inevitable. Factors such as globalization, financial innovation, ethical challenges, suboptimal institutional designs, and the bounded rationality of decision makers may create conditions that result in future crises.
